properties.name: nitida.signing.kek
properties.description: Base64-encoded 32-byte KEK for workshop signing keys.

properties.name: nitida.signing.kek-version
properties.description: Active KEK version stored with encrypted workshop keys.

properties.name: nitida.files.root
properties.description: Directory on disk for sanitized uploaded images.

properties.name: nitida.privacy.policy-version
properties.description: Current privacy policy version required for customer consent.

properties.name: nitida.login.ip-limit
properties.description: Max failed logins per IP within the rate-limit window.

properties.name: nitida.register.ip-limit
properties.description: Max account registrations per client IP per hour (each one computes an Argon2id hash).

properties.name: nitida.admin.totp-required
properties.description: Platform admins must enroll TOTP to get admin privileges (default true; only the dev profile turns it off).

properties.name: nitida.dev.seed-password
properties.description: Dev profile only: password of the development accounts. Empty = the development data is not created.

properties.name: nitida.events.resubmit-interval
properties.description: How often incomplete event publications are resubmitted (ISO-8601, default PT5M).

properties.name: springdoc.api-docs.enabled
properties.description: Serve the generated OpenAPI JSON (/v3/api-docs). Off outside the dev profile.

properties.name: springdoc.swagger-ui.enabled
properties.description: Serve Swagger UI. Only the dev profile turns it on.

properties.name: scalar.enabled
properties.description: Scalar API reference UI; kept off.
